steps.title: A king boxed in
steps.body: If the king has no flight square because its own pawns block the front, a rook or queen on the back rank gives checkmate. Look for it, and make a gap for your own king.
Black's king is boxed in by f7, g7 and h7.

wrong.default: Is there a forcing move on the back rank?

steps.onSuccess: Ra8 is checkmate because the king has no escape.

steps.q: How do you avoid being back-rank mated?
options: Give your king an escape square
steps.why: A single pawn move gives the king air.

solution: A rook or queen mate against a king boxed in by its own pawns.
